name: KslKatz BYOVD: AllowedProcessName Written Under KslD Service Key
description: Detects any process writing the AllowedProcessName registry value under a Services\KslD key — the primary kslkatz signal. The KslD driver authenticates callers via a plain-string comparison against this value (an NT device path). Writing it to an attacker-controlled path defeats the check. The KslD service is NOT covered by Defender tamper protection. Real attacker target: HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\KslD. HIGH-CONFIDENCE detection; no legitimate baseline for non-Defender processes touching this value.
query: registry where registry.path : "*\\Services\\KslD*" and registry.value : "AllowedProcessName" and not process.name : ("MsMpEng.exe", "HealthService.exe", "TrustedInstaller.exe", "services.exe", "MpDefenderCoreService.exe")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: KslKatz BYOVD: KslD Service ImagePath Redirected to Non-Protected Path
description: Detects the ImagePath registry value under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\KslD being written to a path outside the protected Windows Defender driver directory (\drivers\wd\). KslKatz uses ChangeServiceConfigW to redirect this path toward a vulnerable 333KB KslD.sys at an attacker-controlled location, enabling BYOVD driver load. This service key is NOT protected by Defender tamper protection.
query: registry where registry.path : "*\\Services\\KslD\\ImagePath" and not registry.data.strings : ("*\\drivers\\wd\\*", "*\\System32\\drivers\\wd\\*") and not process.name : ("TrustedInstaller.exe", "MsMpEng.exe", "services.exe", "MpDefenderCoreService.exe")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: KslKatz BYOVD: KslD.sys Vulnerable Driver Dropped Outside Protected Directory
description: Detects creation of a file named KslD.sys or vKslD.sys at any path outside the protected Windows Defender driver directory (\System32\drivers\wd\). KslKatz deploys a no-fix Microsoft-signed vulnerable KslD.sys (~333KB) to an attacker-controlled location before starting the service. The file being Microsoft-signed does not exclude it from this rule — BYOVD specifically weaponizes legitimately signed vulnerable drivers. Complement with hash-based detections from the Microsoft Vulnerable Driver Blocklist.
query: file where event.action : ("creation", "overwrite") and file.name : ("KslD.sys", "vKslD.sys", "ksld.sys") and not file.path : ("*\\System32\\drivers\\wd\\*", "*\\SysWOW64\\drivers\\wd\\*") and not process.name : ("TrustedInstaller.exe", "WaaSMedicAgent.exe", "MsMpEng.exe")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: KslKatz BYOVD: User-Mode Process Opening KslD Kernel Device Object
description: Detects any user-mode process issuing CreateFile to the \Device\KslD or \\.\KslD kernel device object. This is a required step in kslkatz: the framework opens the device to issue SubCmd 12 MmCopyMemory IOCTLs for physical LSASS memory reads that bypass PPL. A user-mode open of this device object by a non-Defender binary is anomalous with no legitimate baseline. NOTE: On a clean host without the KslD driver loaded, this open will fail with ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND or ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED from the Object Manager — the access attempt still generates telemetry.
query: sequence by host.id, process.entity_id with maxspan=5m [process where event.type == "start" and not process.name : ("MsMpEng.exe", "HealthService.exe", "WdNisDrv.exe")] [file where file.path : ("*\\KslD", "*\\.\\KslD") or (event.action : "open" and file.name : "KslD")]
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: KslKatz BYOVD: LSASS OpenProcess with VM_READ from Non-Whitelisted Binary
description: Detects a process requesting PROCESS_VM_READ access to lsass.exe. CRITICAL CAVEAT: kslkatz reads LSASS from KERNEL MODE via KslD.sys MmCopyMemory, bypassing LSA Protection (PPL) — a successful kslkatz run will NOT generate this event because the read originates in ring 0. This detection targets: (a) non-kslkatz credential dumpers; (b) test simulations of the access primitive; (c) kslkatz fallback to user-mode path. For kslkatz-specific attribution, correlate with the BYOVD precursor rules (AllowedProcessName write, ImagePath redirect, KslD.sys drop) which fire BEFORE credential extraction and are the highest-value detections for this specific framework.
query: sequence by host.id with maxspan=30m [registry where registry.path : "*\\Services\\KslD*" and registry.value : "AllowedProcessName"] [process where event.type == "start"] [process where event.action == "process_accessed" and target.process.name : "lsass.exe" and process.name != null and not process.name : ("MsMpEng.exe", "csrss.exe", "werfault.exe", "WerFault.exe", "svchost.exe", "taskmgr.exe", "SenseIR.exe", "SecurityHealthService.exe")]
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
